WITH trader_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
total_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM trader_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.count,
    tc.count::numeric / ts.total_count::numeric as share,
    ts.avg_count
  FROM trader_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total_stats ts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    count,
    share,
    count - avg_count as excess
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE count > avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: Foreign key constraints are maintained: every advancedbehavior.translink references a valid transactionrecord.transreg, and every transactionrecord.trdref references a valid trader.tradereg. Inner joins filter out any violating records.
